metadata.title: FIFA Mobile 18 Season 2 - Cartas de Eventos
metadata.stats_generation: Each event card inherits 30 detailed stats from the matched base card (same player), then scaled linearly by (event_ovr - base_ovr) * 0.42 and clamped 20-99. For unmatchable rows (23 cards), a synthetic profile is derived from OVR and position (GK boosted for GK stats). This is an approximation; exact event stats are not published by the source sites.
